title: Canonical etale-chart self-product and source-section comparisons
statement: Use the finite purity datum P [def-pur-conventions], affine space A=Aff^d_Y with d≥0 [def-sbc-affine-space], and fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]. For h:U→Y and an etale Y-map e:U→A with pe=h [def-weil-etale-morphism], define selfMap:U×_Y U→A×_Y A as pullback.map(e,e,id_Y). Define sourceLift:U×_Y U→(A×_Y A)×_A U by selfMap and the first projection. The typing facts selfMap_fst and sourceLift_geometry assert its first-projection equation, and, when h is separated and finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], that sourceLift is separated etale quasi-compact and sends Delta_U to the base-changed Delta_A section. If h is smooth of pure relative dimension d [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], Y is finite type over k, and N is the graph-normalized compact-support datum [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], define sourceOrdinary:C(p_U,Delta_U)≅Le* C(p_A,Delta_A), where C is [def-pur-section-invariant], by inverse etale section locality for sourceLift [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data], followed by inverse smooth section base change [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry]. Define source as its actual pro-etale transport by the canonical sourceComparison and pullComparison [def-pur-section-pullback-site-comparisons]. No DNC/vector-factor compatibility or orientation theorem is included.

def sourceOrdinary (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {U Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (d : ℕ) (h : U ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (e : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y) [Etale e]
    (w : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y) = h)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
